memory_update.text: Murata/MRAAY should be retained as the reference anchor for high-end AI-server MLCC evidence, pricing discipline, and capacity-tightness checks.

Vishay/VSH enters the underfollowed lane as a hypothesis: broad passive/discrete exposure to server power supplies and computing applications is clear, but direct high-end AI-server MLCC qualification evidence is not yet proven.

Bel Fuse/BELFB enters the underfollowed lane for AI data-center power shelves, 48V architectures, DC-DC conversion, magnetics, and connectivity; next layer should separate AI-driven growth from acquisition/cyclical growth.

Vicor/VICR is a high-relevance but larger-cap underfollowed power-delivery candidate; direct AI accelerator power evidence is strong, but customer/platform concentration and design-win durability are the core falsification points.
The chokepoint may split into two tracks: high-end MLCC/passive supply tightness and 48V-to-point-of-load AI accelerator power-delivery architecture.

Need another pass on US-listed or OTC ADR passives suppliers such as Samsung Electro-Mechanics, TDK, Taiyo Yuden, Kyocera, Yageo, and Panasonic-related instruments where accessible; current pass prioritized US exchange-listed or US-traded names with clearer source availability.

node: AI-server passive components and board-level power delivery, including high-end MLCCs
summary: This Layer 1B pass expands the universe around a narrow AI-server passives and board-level power-delivery node. The evidence supports Murata as the reference anchor for high-end AI-server MLCC tightness, while the underfollowed US-listed discovery lane should track Vishay for broad passive/power component optionality, Bel Fuse for rack/server power shelves and magnetics, and Vicor for high-density 48V-to-point-of-load AI accelerator power delivery. The key Serenity question is whether the real chokepoint is high-end MLCC capacity specifically, or the wider power-delivery stack around 48V racks, power shelves, inductors, magnetics, capacitors, and high-current conversion modules.
